title: The Basket of Clean Napkins
youtube_title: The Basket of Clean Napkins | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who is tired is already a gentle skill.
summary: At a library return desk and the rainy steps, a basket of clean napkins for the long table is awkward for one person. Noemi notices Mr. Ade struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
